reasoning: Build subtrees in increasing required size. Initially every size1 vertex is an available leaf tree. To create a vertex of size c, choose at least two available components whose sizes sum to c-1, replace them by the new component of size c, and continue. Enumerating component multiplicities, not labeled subsets, avoids duplicate branches; memoize the sorted forest and next internal vertex. Every valid tree admits this construction order, and each completed merge is a valid subtree, so the existence search is both necessary and sufficient for n<=24.
